story_quests.title: First Blood
story_quests.description: Prove yourself by destroying your first enemy ship in sector space.

story_quests.title: Claim Your Ground
story_quests.description: Find and claim the derelict asteroid station that will become your home base.

story_quests.title: The Rival Appears
story_quests.description: A signal from Captain Dread — your rival. They've been watching. Hunt them down... or run.

story_quests.title: The Graveyard Calls
story_quests.description: Rumors of ancient tech in the Ship Graveyard. Get there before Dread does.

story_quests.title: The Sovereign's Warning
story_quests.description: The Void Collective sends a message. Something is coming from the deep sectors.

story_quests.title: End of the Line
story_quests.description: Captain Dread has allied with the deep sector threat. One final battle.

side_quest_templates.title: Rescue Mission
side_quest_templates.description: A crew member's family is being held by {faction} ships in {sector}.

side_quest_templates.title: Cargo Run
side_quest_templates.description: Deliver {cargo} to the station in {sector}. No questions asked.

side_quest_templates.title: Bounty: {target_name}
side_quest_templates.description: Bring in {target_name}, dead or alive. Last seen in {sector}.
